scope: Equatorial lateral contact reaction of a frozen mid-depth patch under the fixed-entrance first bend. Gauge covers twelve passing sections with the prior twelve-site section weight. Signed forces are relative to matched unforced, in native patch force units.
geometry: Use the archived section-translation operator, column 0. Pitch 0.01 mouth radii per bare bond length. Local hoop, compression, flow rate and contact weights frozen at the middle. Angularly uniform tangent component in the small equatorial patch. Two alternative incoming material offsets, zero in the laboratory or local wall offset, represent hypotheses.

reviews.verbatim: Scoped clear for the signed mid-depth patch force under the archived fixed-entrance first bend at 5 × 10⁻⁶ mouth radii and for its dependence on incoming material and finite patch span. The whole-mouth force and free acceleration remain open.
resolved_findings: Replaced the entrance-moving complementary shape with the fixed-entrance archived shape for the reported drive; independently check both shapes against uniform translation.
Larger step exceeded the declared weak-drive tolerance; retained that tolerance and measured fresh runs at the smaller displacement.
Length control moves both boundaries. Report span dependence and distinguish centered-feed force from the excess over a matched translation.
